_comment: CT-2 Tier-A reconstruct-root KAT oracle. Generated by gen_ct2_fixture.py from a regtest shekyld. Each chain's block[h].curve_tree_root is the C++ consensus header root; the Rust KAT reconstructs it from the coinbase leaf inputs.
regen_audit_note: Regenerated 2026-09-14 for PL-D3 (docs/design/FCMP_SPEND_LINKABILITY.md §6.2): the 0x07 field carries one 64-byte CM || record entry per output and the leaf's 4th scalar is CM.x, so every root moved.
